subtitle.zh: 先认识发音器官，再建立美式元音的声音坐标。
subtitle.en: Learn how your mouth makes vowel sounds.

description.zh: 从26个字母走向音标，分清元音、辅音与清浊。
description.en: Learn letters, sounds, vowels, and consonants.

body.zh: 字母用来拼写单词，音标用来记录声音；两者不是一一对应。ship 有4个字母，但通常是 /ʃ ɪ p/ 3个音。看到陌生词可先猜，再查美式词典和录音确认。
body.en: Letters spell words. IPA symbols show sounds. One sound can use two letters. Check a new word in a US dictionary.

body.zh: 发元音时口腔气流通常没有明显阻碍，元音常是音节核心。发辅音时气流会受阻或收窄；/j/ 和 /w/ 很像元音，但在英语音节里通常像辅音工作。
body.en: Air flows fairly freely in a vowel. Your mouth blocks or narrows the air for most consonants. The sounds in yes and we act as consonants.

body.zh: 轻触喉部比较 /s/ 与 /z/：/z/ 通常有声带振动，/s/ 没有。不要挤压喉部，也不要在辅音后加“呃”。这会帮助你以后读复数词尾。
body.en: Touch your throat gently. Feel the voice in z. Keep the air quiet in s. Do not add an extra vowel.

prompt.zh: ship 通常有几个音？
prompt.en: How many sounds are in ship?

explanation.zh: sh 共同表示 /ʃ/，加 /ɪ/ 与 /p/，共有3个音。
explanation.en: The letters sh make one sound. There are three sounds.

prompt.zh: 哪个符号表示元音？

explanation.zh: /ɪ/ 是 ship 的元音；/s/、/p/ 是辅音。
explanation.en: The middle sound in ship is a vowel.

prompt.zh: 哪个声音通常有声带振动？

explanation.zh: /z/ 是浊辅音。用轻触喉部来体会，不要用力挤喉。
explanation.en: Z uses your voice. Touch your throat gently to feel it.

prompt.zh: 遇见新单词，什么做法可靠？
prompt.en: What helps you check a new word?

explanation.zh: 拼写提供线索，词典美式音标与录音帮助验证读法。
explanation.en: Spelling gives clues. US IPA and audio help you check.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: ship 中间是放松的 /ɪ/。先注意中间的元音，再听首尾辅音。
explanation.en: Ship has the relaxed vowel /ɪ/.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: 先让 /s/ 的气流连续，再接 /i/。这是一音节，不在两音之间加额外元音。
explanation.en: Move from s into the vowel in see. Keep it one beat.

title.zh: 前元音：从 see 到 cat

description.zh: 比较 /i ɪ ɛ æ/，改变舌位和开口度。
description.en: Hear four vowels made near the front of your mouth.

body.zh: /i/ 如 see，舌位高且靠前；/ɪ/ 如 sit，舌位略低，更放松。不要只靠把声音拖长来区分，口腔位置也不同。
body.en: For /i/, keep your tongue high and forward. For /ɪ/, relax it a little lower. Length alone is not the difference.

body.zh: /ɛ/ 如 bed，开口比 /ɪ/ 更大；/æ/ 如 cat，开口更大，舌前部较低。不要把 cat 念成 ket，也不要用汉语拼音“ai”替代。
body.en: Open more for /ɛ/ in bed. Open more again for /æ/ in cat. Keep one steady vowel in cat.

body.zh: 最小对立词只改变一个音，如 pen 与 pan。先固定 /p/ 和 /n/，只换中间元音；每次录音只检查一个目标，容易听出变化。
body.en: A sound pair changes just one sound. Keep p and n the same in pen and pan. Listen to the middle sound.

prompt.zh: see 的元音是哪一个？
prompt.en: What is the vowel in see?

explanation.zh: see 用较高、较前的 /i/。
explanation.en: See has /i/, with a high front tongue position.

prompt.zh: 哪个词含 /ɪ/？

explanation.zh: sit /sɪt/ 的元音放松，seat /sit/ 用 /i/。
explanation.en: Sit has /ɪ/. Seat has /i/.

prompt.zh: bed 与 bad 主要差在哪里？
prompt.en: What changes in bed and bad?

explanation.zh: 首尾 /b d/ 相同，中间 /ɛ/ 换成 /æ/。
explanation.en: The first and last sounds stay the same. The vowel changes.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: pen 是 /pɛn/，/ɛ/ 介于 pin 的 /ɪ/ 与 pan 的 /æ/ 之间。
explanation.en: Pen has /ɛ/. Listen for a middle opening.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: ship /ʃɪp/，不要只凭音长判断，还要听元音音质。
explanation.en: Ship has /ɪ/. Listen to the vowel quality, not just length.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: red 用 /ɛ/，bag 用 /æ/。让 bag 的开口更大。
explanation.en: Use /ɛ/ in red and open more for /æ/ in bag.

description.zh: 学习 /ɑ ɔ ʊ u/，接纳合理的地区差异。
description.en: Learn back vowels and common US differences.

body.zh: /ɑ/ 如 father、hot，开口较大，舌靠后。部分美式口音区分 cot /kɑt/ 与 caught /kɔt/，另一部分合并；这两种都存在，听力要认识，评测不要把合并判为错。
body.en: Open your mouth for /ɑ/. Some US speakers use a different vowel in caught. Others say cot and caught alike. Both patterns are common.

body.zh: /u/ 如 food，舌位较高，唇形通常收圆；/ʊ/ 如 good，更松、更低。美式 /u/ 的舌位会随说话人变化，不需要把嘴唇极度撅起。
body.en: For /u/ in food, round your lips gently. For /ʊ/ in good, relax your mouth. Do not push your lips too far out.

title.zh: 不要按 oo 一律读

body.zh: 同样写作 oo，food 常用 /u/，book 常用 /ʊ/，blood 则用 /ʌ/。本课先掌握 food 与 book 的听辨，再把例外写进单词册。
body.en: The letters oo do not always make one sound. Food and book have different vowels. Keep a note of new examples.

prompt.zh: food 的元音是？

explanation.zh: food 通常为 /fud/，与 foot /fʊt/ 的元音不同。
explanation.en: Food has /u/. Foot has /ʊ/.

prompt.zh: 哪个词含 /ʊ/？

explanation.zh: book 用 /ʊ/；moon 用 /u/；hot 用 /ɑ/。
explanation.en: Book has /ʊ/. Moon has /u/.

prompt.zh: cot 和 caught 的读法应该怎样看？
prompt.en: What is true about cot and caught?

options: Both merged and distinct US forms exist
questions.answer: Both merged and distinct US forms exist

explanation.zh: 美式口音存在合并和区分，不能只用一种地区口音评判所有人。
explanation.en: Some US speakers merge them. Others keep them different.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: food 结尾是 /d/，元音为 /u/。这组同时改变元音和尾音，先整体识别。
explanation.en: Food has /u/ and ends with /d/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: book 的元音是 /ʊ/，不是 /æ/ 或 /aɪ/。
explanation.en: Book has the vowel /ʊ/.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: good 的 /ʊ/ 放松，food 的 /u/ 口腔位置不同。保持两个词清楚。
explanation.en: Relax the vowel in good. Use /u/ in food.

title.zh: 中元音、弱读与 r 音

description.zh: 认识 /ʌ ə ɝ ɚ/，把重音也听进去。
description.en: Hear center vowels and vowels with r.

body.zh: /ʌ/ 如 cup，常在重读音节；/ə/ 如 about 的第一个音节，是常见弱读元音。二者在不同口音中音质可接近，但在词里的重音角色不同。
body.en: Cup has a stressed center vowel. The first vowel in about is weak. Stress is part of the difference.

body.zh: bird 的重读元音常记作 /ɝ/，teacher 末尾的非重读元音常记作 /ɚ/。舌尖可微抬或舌身聚拢，舌头不必接触上腭；不要把它拆成汉语“儿”的强烈卷舌。
body.en: Bird has a strong r vowel. Teacher ends with a weak r vowel. Your tongue need not touch the roof of your mouth.

body.zh: 一些词典把 /ɝ/ 写作 /ɜr/ 或 /ɜːr/。本课程将 /ə/、/ɚ/ 单列为学习卡，因此卡片数不等于唯一的音位数。先认同一个词的声音，再理解不同标法。
body.en: Dictionaries may write the same US sound in different ways. Our cards show weak vowels separately. Read the dictionary key when symbols differ.

prompt.zh: 哪个音节通常弱读为 /ə/？

explanation.zh: about 重音在第二音节；第一音节常是轻短的 /ə/。
explanation.en: The first part is weak. The second part is stressed.

prompt.zh: bird 的元音是哪一个？

explanation.zh: bird 的重读元音有美式 r 色彩，常记为 /ɝ/。
explanation.en: Bird has a stressed r vowel, /ɝ/.

prompt.zh: teacher 末尾通常用哪个符号？
prompt.en: What is the weak ending in teacher?

explanation.zh: teacher 末尾是非重读 r 音元音 /ɚ/。
explanation.en: Teacher ends in the weak r vowel /ɚ/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: cup 用 /ʌ/，cap 用 /æ/，keep 用 /i/。
explanation.en: Cup has /ʌ/. The mouth stays relaxed.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: bird 的 r 色彩在元音内部，不要漏掉。
explanation.en: Bird has an r sound within its vowel.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: her 可重读 /hɝ/；teacher 的末尾 /ɚ/ 较轻。先清晰，再尝试自然轻重。
explanation.en: Say her clearly. Keep the last part of teacher light.

description.zh: 用一个音节完成 /eɪ aɪ ɔɪ aʊ oʊ/。
description.en: Move smoothly through five diphthongs.

body.zh: 双元音在一个音节内从一个位置滑向另一个位置。/eɪ/ 如 day，/aɪ/ 如 my，不能拆成两个有间隔的汉语音节。
body.en: A diphthong moves within one beat. Day and my each have one beat. Keep the movement smooth.

body.zh: /ɔɪ/ 如 boy，从较圆的口形滑向较前的位置；/aʊ/ 如 now，从较开的位置滑向圆唇。保持气流连续，结尾不要再加一个独立元音。
body.en: Boy starts with rounded lips. Now moves toward rounded lips. Keep the air moving without a break.

body.zh: 本课用 /oʊ/ 记录 go 的美式元音。英式词典里常见 /əʊ/，是另一种常用记法和口音模型；查词时选择 US 录音，保持练习目标一致。
body.en: We use /oʊ/ for US go. UK entries often show /əʊ/. Use the US audio for this course.

prompt.zh: day 的元音是？

explanation.zh: day 是 /deɪ/，在一个音节里平滑移动。
explanation.en: Day has /eɪ/ in one beat.

prompt.zh: 哪个词含 /ɔɪ/？

explanation.zh: boy 的元音是 /ɔɪ/；buy 是 /aɪ/。
explanation.en: Boy has /ɔɪ/. Buy has /aɪ/.

prompt.zh: my 通常有几个音节？
prompt.en: How many beats are in my?

explanation.zh: /aɪ/ 是一个音节里的滑动，不是两个独立音节。
explanation.en: The moving vowel stays in one beat.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: now 用 /aʊ/，no 用 /oʊ/，new 常用 /u/。
explanation.en: Now has /aʊ/. No has /oʊ/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: home 中间是 /oʊ/，结尾 /m/ 要闭唇。
explanation.en: Home has /oʊ/ and ends with closed lips for m.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: go、home 用 /oʊ/；now 用 /aʊ/。三个词各一音节，不把滑动拆开。
explanation.en: Use /oʊ/ in go and home. Use /aʊ/ in now.

description.zh: 综合听辨、符号识别与自我检查。
description.en: Check your vowel listening and reading.

body.zh: 先回忆舌位与开口，再看词的拼写。ship/sheep 和 bed/bad 能检查舌位；food/good 能检查后元音。听不稳时回到一组词，不必一次练全部。
body.en: Remember the mouth movement before the spelling. Use one sound pair at a time. Repeat the pair that is hard for you.

body.zh: 读音标时，同时找重音号 ˈ 与弱读元音。about 的第一音节轻，teacher 的末尾轻；知道符号但每一拍都一样重，仍会影响听懂。
body.en: Look for the stress mark as well as the vowels. Make weak parts lighter. Equal stress can make a word hard to follow.

body.zh: 美式英语内部有差异，cot/caught 合并是一例。先追求别人能区分你要说的词；录音回放用于发现可练习的线索，不应当作专业诊断或绝对评分。
body.en: US speech has real differences. Aim to make the word clear. A recording can guide practice, but it is not a full diagnosis.

prompt.zh: 哪个词的元音最开放？
prompt.en: Which word has the most open front vowel?

explanation.zh: /ɪ ɛ æ/ 中，sat 的 /æ/ 口腔开度最大。
explanation.en: The /æ/ in sat has the largest opening of these three.

prompt.zh: 哪个词含弱读 /ə/？

explanation.zh: about 首音节通常是 /ə/，重音在后面。
explanation.en: About starts with weak /ə/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: sheep 用 /i/，不要与 ship 的 /ɪ/ 混淆。
explanation.en: Sheep has /i/. Ship has /ɪ/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: boy 用 /ɔɪ/；另外两词分别是 /aɪ/ 与 /eɪ/。
explanation.en: Boy has /ɔɪ/. Buy and bay have different moving vowels.

prompt.zh: 哪句话符合本课的美式语音目标？
prompt.en: Which statement fits our US sound goal?

options: Only one US accent is correct
Common US accents may merge these vowels
questions.answer: Common US accents may merge these vowels

explanation.zh: 教材用统一符号帮助学习，同时认可常见口音差异。
explanation.en: We use a clear teaching model and accept common US differences.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: The teacher has a good book.
questions.answer: The teacher has a good book.

explanation.zh: teacher 末尾弱读；good、book 都用 /ʊ/。一次先检查一个目标。
explanation.en: Keep the end of teacher light. Use /ʊ/ in good and book.

questions.audioText: The teacher has a good book.
questions.target: The teacher has a good book.

subtitle.zh: 把24个辅音放进词里，练清楚而不多加音。
subtitle.en: Learn 24 consonants in clear, simple words.

description.zh: 练习 /p b t d k ɡ/ 的部位、清浊与词尾。
description.en: Make six stop sounds with your lips and tongue.

body.zh: /p b/ 双唇闭合；/t d/ 舌尖或舌端接近上齿龈；/k ɡ/ 舌后部接近软腭。气流短暂关闭后释放，不要把每个辅音念成完整汉语音节。
body.en: Close your lips for p and b. Use the ridge behind your upper teeth for t and d. Use the back of your tongue for k and g.

concepts.example: pat, bat, ten, den, coat, goat
concepts.translation: 轻拍、蝙蝠、十、兽穴、外套、山羊
concepts.audioText: pat, bat, ten, den, coat, goat

body.zh: /p t k/ 为清音，/b d ɡ/ 为浊音。美式重读音节开头的 /p t k/ 常有较明显送气；在 s 后送气较弱，但 stay 的 t 不因此变成音位 /d/。
body.en: P, t, and k are voiceless. B, d, and g use voice. A strong puff often follows p, t, or k at the start of a stressed beat.

body.zh: cap、cat、back 的尾音需要做出对应的闭合动作。句末可以没有明显爆破声，但不能靠加“呃”把词变成两个音节；先慢读到位，再练自然语流。
body.en: Make the final closure in cap, cat, and back. The release can be quiet. Do not add an extra vowel after the last sound.

prompt.zh: 哪组用双唇闭合？

explanation.zh: /p b/ 都先闭合双唇，清浊不同。
explanation.en: P and b close both lips. Their voicing differs.

prompt.zh: coat 与 goat 改变哪个音？
prompt.en: Which sound changes in coat and goat?

explanation.zh: coat 用 /k/，goat 用 /ɡ/，其余 /oʊt/ 相同。
explanation.en: Coat starts with k. Goat starts with g.

prompt.zh: 读 cat 结尾的正确练习是？

options: Drop the last sound every time

explanation.zh: 完成 /t/ 的阻塞动作；不用加额外元音。
explanation.en: Make the t closure without adding a vowel.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: coat 开头是清音 /k/；注意舌后部的短暂阻塞。
explanation.en: Coat starts with voiceless k.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: bat 开头用 /b/，结尾用 /t/。
explanation.en: Bat starts with b and ends with t.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: big 结尾 /ɡ/，cat 开头 /k/；慢读时先把两个词的动作做清楚。
explanation.en: Finish big with g. Start cat with k. Keep the words clear.

description.zh: 区分 /f v θ ð/，不用汉语近似音替代。
description.en: Let air pass between lips and teeth or tongue and teeth.

body.zh: /f/ 与 /v/ 都让上齿轻触下唇，气流从缝隙通过。/v/ 通常带声带振动，不是双唇收圆的 /w/；不用咬紧下唇。
body.en: Touch your lower lip gently with your upper teeth. Let air pass for f. Add voice for v. Do not close or round both lips.

body.zh: /θ/ 如 thin，/ð/ 如 this，舌尖轻靠或略伸出上下齿之间，气流继续通过。/θ/ 清音，/ð/ 浊音；把舌尖放太后容易变 /s z/。
body.en: Place your tongue tip lightly at or between your teeth. Let air pass. Thin is voiceless. This uses voice.

body.zh: leaf 与 leave 靠末尾 /f v/ 区分；breath 与 breathe 靠 /θ ð/ 区分，元音也不同。先延长摩擦气流来体会，再回到自然速度。
body.en: Leaf and leave have different last sounds. Feel the air at the end. Practice slowly, then return to a normal speed.

prompt.zh: 哪个声音用声带振动？

explanation.zh: /v/ 与 /f/ 部位相近，但 /v/ 是浊音。
explanation.en: V uses voice. F is voiceless.

prompt.zh: thin 的首音是？
prompt.en: What is the first sound in thin?

explanation.zh: thin 首音是舌齿清擦音 /θ/，不是 /s/ 或 /t/。
explanation.en: Thin starts with /θ/, with air passing at the teeth.

prompt.zh: this 的 th 与哪个词相同？
prompt.en: Which word has the same th as this?

explanation.zh: this 与 they 都用浊音 /ð/；think、three 用 /θ/。
explanation.en: This and they start with voiced /ð/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: van 是 /væn/，上齿轻触下唇并发声。
explanation.en: Van starts with voiced v.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: thin 的 /θ/ 让气流从牙齿附近通过。
explanation.en: Thin has a steady air sound at the teeth.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: this 用 /ð/，thin 用 /θ/，leaf 结尾 /f/。三个摩擦动作不要变成塞音。
explanation.en: Use voice for this, quiet air for thin, and f at the end of leaf.

title.zh: 从 s 到 sh，再到 h

description.zh: 学习 /s z ʃ ʒ h/，听清摩擦位置。
description.en: Hear five sounds made with moving air.

body.zh: /s/ 如 sip，/z/ 如 zip，舌尖接近齿龈但不完全堵住气流。/z/ 是浊音，/s/ 是清音；不要用汉语“丝”里的元音拖尾。
body.en: For s and z, make a narrow air path near the ridge behind your teeth. Use voice for z. Avoid an extra vowel at the end.

body.zh: /ʃ/ 如 ship，/ʒ/ 如 vision 中间，舌位比 /s z/ 稍后，唇可略圆。/ʒ/ 常在词中，不要因为拼写是 s 就读 /s/。
body.en: Move your tongue a little back for sh. Its voiced partner is the middle sound in vision. Spelling alone does not choose the sound.

body.zh: /h/ 如 hat，气流在喉部形成轻微摩擦，随后进入元音。不要把它读成舌后用力摩擦的汉语“喝”；hour 的 h 不发音，需要查词确认。
body.en: For h, breathe gently into the vowel. Do not scrape the back of your mouth. The h in hour is silent.

prompt.zh: 哪个词首音是 /ʃ/？

explanation.zh: ship 中 sh 共同表示 /ʃ/。
explanation.en: The letters sh in ship make /ʃ/.

prompt.zh: vision 中间的 s 发什么音？
prompt.en: What sound is in the middle of vision?

explanation.zh: vision 通常为 /ˈvɪʒən/，中间是浊擦音 /ʒ/。
explanation.en: Vision has voiced /ʒ/ in the middle.

prompt.zh: 哪个词开头的 h 不发音？

explanation.zh: hour 以元音 /aʊ/ 起头，因此也会说 an hour。
explanation.en: Hour starts with the vowel /aʊ/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: sip 首音是 /s/，与 ship 的 /ʃ/ 位置不同。
explanation.en: Sip starts with s, further forward than sh.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: hat 开头有轻呼气 /h/。
explanation.en: Hat starts with a light h sound.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: She 首音 /ʃ/，has 结尾 /z/，hat 首音 /h/。按词逐个检查，再连成句。
explanation.en: Use sh in she, z at the end of has, and h in hat.

description.zh: 认识 /tʃ dʒ m n ŋ/，让气流走对通道。
description.en: Learn ch, j, and three nose sounds.

body.zh: /tʃ/ 如 chair，/dʒ/ 如 jam，都先短暂阻塞，再释放成摩擦。它们各算一个常用音位，不要把 chair 念成两段；/dʒ/ 是浊音。
body.en: Ch and j begin with a short stop and end with moving air. Keep each sound joined. J uses voice.

body.zh: /m/ 闭双唇，/n/ 舌端抵近上齿龈，/ŋ/ 舌后部抬向软腭；三者都让气流经鼻腔。不要为了发鼻音使劲捏鼻或堵住呼吸。
body.en: Close your lips for m, use your tongue tip for n, and use the back of your tongue for ng. Let air pass through your nose.

concepts.translation: 总和；太阳；唱的过去分词

body.zh: sing 通常以 /ŋ/ 结尾，不额外加 /ɡ/；finger 常有 /ŋɡ/。不能只看 ng 就决定是否带 /ɡ/，用录音与音标核对。
body.en: Sing ends with /ŋ/ and no extra g. Finger normally has /ŋɡ/. Check each word instead of guessing from ng alone.

prompt.zh: jam 的第一个音是？
prompt.en: What is the first sound in jam?

explanation.zh: 字母 j 在 jam 中对应 /dʒ/；音标 /j/ 是 yes 的首音。
explanation.en: Jam starts with /dʒ/. IPA /j/ is the sound in yes.

prompt.zh: 哪个鼻音需要闭双唇？
prompt.en: Which nose sound closes both lips?

explanation.zh: /m/ 闭唇，声音仍可经鼻腔继续。
explanation.en: For m, your lips close while air passes through your nose.

prompt.zh: sing 的常见结尾是什么？

explanation.zh: sing 通常无额外 /ɡ/；finger 则常有 /ŋɡ/。
explanation.en: Sing normally ends in /ŋ/ alone.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: chair 开头 /tʃ/ 先阻塞再摩擦，share 只有 /ʃ/ 摩擦。
explanation.en: Chair begins with a stop before the air sound.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: sun 结尾 /n/，舌端接近上齿龈。
explanation.en: Sun ends with n, using the tongue tip.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: sing 结尾 /ŋ/；in 结尾 /n/；June 首音 /dʒ/。不要给 sing 增加 g。
explanation.en: Keep ng at the end of sing. Use n in in and j in June.

description.zh: 完成 /l r w j/，保持词中的辅音相连。
description.en: Learn l, r, w, y, and consonant groups.

title.zh: l 和 r 的关键动作

body.zh: /l/ 舌尖常接触齿龈，气流从舌两侧经过；美式 /r/ 常写成 /r/，实际常接近 [ɹ]，舌头不接触上腭。light/right 先慢读，再用最小对立词听辨。
body.en: For l, touch the ridge with your tongue tip. For US r, do not touch the roof of your mouth. Practice light and right slowly.

body.zh: /w/ 如 we，双唇先收圆再滑向元音；/j/ 如 yes，是较高前舌位滑向元音。音标 /j/ 不是英文 j 字母名，也不是 jam 的 /dʒ/。
body.en: Round your lips for w, then move into the vowel. For /j/ in yes, start with a high front tongue. IPA /j/ is not the sound in jam.

body.zh: stop、play、desk 中几个辅音可以直接相邻。先慢慢接上每个动作，不在 s 与 t 之间加“呃”；清晰的慢读能逐渐变成自然的连贯读法。
body.en: Consonants can sit next to each other in stop, play, and desk. Move straight between them. Do not add a vowel inside the group.

prompt.zh: light 的首音通常需要什么动作？

options: Touch the ridge with the tongue tip
Close the back of the tongue
questions.answer: Touch the ridge with the tongue tip

explanation.zh: /l/ 的舌尖通常接触上齿龈，气流从两侧通过。
explanation.en: L usually uses tongue-tip contact at the ridge.

prompt.zh: 音标 /j/ 出现在哪个词开头？

explanation.zh: yes /jɛs/；jam 是 /dʒæm/。
explanation.en: Yes starts with /j/. Jam starts with /dʒ/.

prompt.zh: stop 应怎样保持一个音节？
prompt.en: How do you keep stop in one beat?

options: Move from s straight to t
questions.answer: Move from s straight to t

explanation.zh: /s/ 后直接做 /t/ 的闭合动作，不插入元音。
explanation.en: Move directly from s to t without a vowel.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: right 首音是美式 /r/，舌尖不需要接触上腭。
explanation.en: Right starts with US r without tongue-tip contact.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: west 首音 /w/ 用圆唇滑动；vest 的 /v/ 是上齿轻触下唇。
explanation.en: West starts with rounded lips for w.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: we 的 /w/，play 的 /pl/，rain 的 /r/ 分别练；不要把 play 拆成两拍。
explanation.en: Use w in we, keep pl together in play, and use r in rain.

description.zh: 通过近音词与短句，检查24个辅音的关键差异。
description.en: Check consonants in words and a short sentence.

body.zh: 先问气流在哪里受到影响：双唇、唇齿、舌齿、齿龈还是舌后？van 与 fan 同部位，van 与 wan 则部位和方式不同。知道动作才能针对性改进。
body.en: Ask where the air changes: lips, teeth, tongue tip, or tongue back. A mouth check helps you choose what to practice.

body.zh: 塞音先堵住气流，擦音保留缝隙，鼻音让气流经鼻腔。ship 与 chip 的差别在于 chip 开头先有阻塞，不是单纯更大声。
body.en: A stop blocks air. An air sound keeps a small opening. A nose sound lets air pass through the nose. Chip starts with a stop; ship does not.

body.zh: 词单独读清楚后，再放进短句。先保留所有目标动作和词尾，再学习自然连读；不要把“自然”误解成任意吞音。
body.en: Once a word is clear, place it in a short sentence. Keep its important sounds. Natural speech still needs to be easy to understand.

prompt.zh: 哪组是清浊配对？
prompt.en: Which is a voiceless and voiced pair?

explanation.zh: /f v/ 部位与方式相近，主要区别为清浊。
explanation.en: F and v share a place and differ in voice.

prompt.zh: 哪个词通常不在 /ŋ/ 后加 /ɡ/？
prompt.en: Which word has no g after /ŋ/?

explanation.zh: sing 通常只有 /ŋ/ 结尾。finger、angle 一般有 /ŋɡ/。
explanation.en: Sing ends in /ŋ/. Finger and angle usually have /ŋɡ/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: chip 用 /tʃɪp/，首音有阻塞后摩擦，中间是 /ɪ/。
explanation.en: Chip has /tʃ/ and the vowel /ɪ/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: three 开头 /θr/，先让气流通过齿间，再接 r。
explanation.en: Three starts with /θr/. Move straight between them.

prompt.zh: desk 应避免什么？
prompt.en: What should you avoid in desk?

explanation.zh: desk 是一个音节，/sk/ 之间不插入元音。
explanation.en: Desk has one beat. Keep s and k together.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: 检查 have 的 /v/、three 的 /θr/ 与 pens 的 /z/。允许慢读，以清楚为先。
explanation.en: Check v in have, th plus r in three, and z at the end of pens.

subtitle.zh: 把音素接成词：拼读、重音、弱读与词典核实。
subtitle.en: Use spelling clues, stress, and a dictionary.

description.zh: 从 cat、cap 到 cake、cape，建立可验证的拼读线索。
description.en: Use a common spelling clue, then check it.

body.zh: 很多辅音—元音—辅音短词，如 cat、sit、hop，中间是传统拼读教学所说的短元音。这里“短”是教学类别，不代表所有场景下时长都固定。
body.en: Many short words like cat, sit, and hop use a simple vowel. The name short vowel is a learning label, not a fixed length.

body.zh: cap 变 cape、kit 变 kite 时，末尾 e 常不发音，并提示前面的元音改变。这是一条常见规律，不是所有带 e 的词都遵守。
body.en: In cap and cape, final e is silent and the vowel changes. Kit and kite show the same pattern. It is a common clue, not a rule for every word.

body.zh: have、give、love 的末尾 e 不让元音变成字母名音。先用规律尝试，再查录音，给例外建立短语卡，而不是把错误读法练熟。
body.en: Have, give, and love do not follow this pattern. Try the clue, then check. Save an exception with a short phrase.

prompt.zh: cap 加不发音的 e 成为？
prompt.en: Add silent e to cap. What word do you get?

explanation.zh: cape /keɪp/ 中 a 常读 /eɪ/，e 本身不另成音节。
explanation.en: Cape has /eɪ/. Final e adds no beat.

prompt.zh: 哪个词符合常见 silent e 规律？
prompt.en: Which word follows the common silent-e clue?

explanation.zh: kite /kaɪt/ 对应 kit /kɪt/；have 和 give 是例外。
explanation.en: Kite matches the pattern. Give and have are exceptions.

prompt.zh: 看到 love 应该怎样确认？

explanation.zh: love 常为 /lʌv/，不能机械套用末尾 e 规律。
explanation.en: Love has /ʌ/. The spelling clue does not always work.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: cape 元音 /eɪ/；cap 是 /æ/。
explanation.en: Cape has the moving vowel /eɪ/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: kit 的 /ɪ/ 与 kite 的 /aɪ/ 不同。
explanation.en: Kit has /ɪ/, not the moving vowel in kite.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: have 是例外 /hæv/；cape 用 /eɪ/。把规律词和例外放在同一句里对照。
explanation.en: Have is an exception. Cape uses /eɪ/.

description.zh: 发现组合规律，也学会停止不可靠的猜测。
description.en: Read common letter groups and notice exceptions.

body.zh: sh、ch、th 常组成一个辅音；但 ch 在 chair、school、chef 中不同。字母组合是起点，要用常见词积累具体读法。
body.en: Sh, ch, and th often work as teams. But ch differs in chair, school, and chef. Learn a new word with its sound.

body.zh: ee 在 see 中读 /i/；ea 在 team 中也可读 /i/，在 bread 中读 /ɛ/。遇见 ea 不要只记一个结论，要把同音组与例外一起整理。
body.en: Ee in see and ea in team both have /i/. Bread has /ɛ/. Group words by sound as well as spelling.

body.zh: read 的现在时和过去时拼写一样，读音却不同；I read every day 用 /rid/，I read yesterday 用 /rɛd/。句子时间和词典词形说明一起帮助确认。
body.en: Read has the same spelling in the present and past. Its vowel changes. Use the sentence and the dictionary form to choose the sound.

concepts.example: I read every day. I read yesterday.
concepts.translation: 我每天读书。我昨天读了书。
concepts.audioText: I read every day. I read yesterday.

prompt.zh: bread 中 ea 的元音是什么？

explanation.zh: bread /brɛd/ 是 ea 读 /ɛ/ 的常见词。
explanation.en: Bread has /ɛ/, unlike team.

prompt.zh: school 中 ch 读什么？
prompt.en: What sound does ch make in school?

explanation.zh: school /skul/ 的 ch 读 /k/。
explanation.en: Ch in school makes /k/.

prompt.zh: 昨天的 read 应用哪个读音？
prompt.en: How do you say read in this sentence?

explanation.zh: yesterday 表明过去，这里的 read 是过去式 /rɛd/。
explanation.en: Yesterday points to the past. Past read is /rɛd/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: team 的 ea 是 /i/，整个词为 /tim/。
explanation.en: Team has /i/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: bread 用 /ɛ/，不是 breed 的 /i/。
explanation.en: Bread uses the vowel /ɛ/.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: 这里 read 是过去式 /rɛd/。book 用 /ʊ/，不要只照字母猜。
explanation.en: Use past read, /rɛd/, and /ʊ/ in book.

description.zh: 分音节、找重音，让长词变得可处理。
description.en: Break words into beats and find the strong beat.

body.zh: 音节通常围绕一个元音核心，而不是一个元音字母。cake 有一个音节，teacher 有两个；不要用字母个数计算。
body.en: A beat usually has a vowel center. Cake has one beat and teacher has two. Count sounds, not vowel letters.

body.zh: 音标 ˈ 放在重读音节之前。about /əˈbaʊt/ 后一拍重，teacher /ˈtitʃɚ/ 前一拍重；重读通常更突出，不等于只提高音量。
body.en: The mark ˈ comes before the strong beat. About is strong at the end. Teacher is strong at the start. Stress can change pitch, length, and clarity.

body.zh: record 作名词“记录”常重第一音节，作动词“录制”常重第二音节。这类规律只适用于部分词，需要结合词性、句意和词典记录。
body.en: Record often starts strong as a noun and ends strong as a verb. This pattern works for some words, not all. Check the word in a sentence.

prompt.zh: teacher 通常有几个音节？
prompt.en: How many beats are in teacher?

explanation.zh: tea-cher 共两个音节，重音在第一拍。
explanation.en: Teacher has two beats, with the first strong.

prompt.zh: about 的哪一拍重？
prompt.en: Which beat is strong in about?

explanation.zh: ˈ 位于 /baʊt/ 前，标记第二音节重读。
explanation.en: The stress mark comes before the second beat.

prompt.zh: record 作“录制”动词通常重哪拍？
prompt.en: Which beat is often strong in the verb record?

explanation.zh: 动词 record 常用后重音；名词 a record 常用前重音。
explanation.en: The verb record is usually strong on the second beat.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: 听两个音节，第一拍 tea 较突出，末尾 /ɚ/ 较轻。
explanation.en: Teacher has a strong first beat and a light ending.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: Please 后接动词原形；record 在这里是“录制”。
explanation.en: Please is followed by the base verb. Record is an action here.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: about 后重，teacher 前重；不要把每一拍读得一样强。
explanation.en: Make about strong at the end and teacher strong at the start.

description.zh: 听见 schwa，理解为什么熟词在句中变短。
description.en: Hear schwa and light forms in speech.

body.zh: banana 的首尾常用 /ə/，中间 /næ/ 重读。弱读不是随便省略字母，而是固定或常见的声音模式；先在词典里找，再听实际示范。
body.en: The first and last vowels in banana are often /ə/. The middle beat is strong. Weak vowels follow speech patterns; do not drop sounds at random.

body.zh: a、to、and 在不强调时常弱读，如 a /ə/、to /tə/。当对比或强调时可更清楚、更重；弱读不是必须在所有位置使用。
body.en: A and to often become light in a sentence. They can be strong for contrast. A weak form is common, not required everywhere.

body.zh: I want a cup 中，want、cup 往往比 a 更突出。先把关键词读清，再让小词轻一些；不需要追求越来越快。
body.en: In I want a cup, want and cup often stand out. Keep the key words clear and the small word light. You do not need to speak fast.

prompt.zh: banana 通常哪一拍重？
prompt.en: Which beat is strong in banana?

explanation.zh: 重音在中间 /næ/，前后元音常弱读为 /ə/。
explanation.en: The middle beat is strong. The others are light.

prompt.zh: 不强调的 a 常怎样读？
prompt.en: How is a often said when it is light?

explanation.zh: 不强调的冠词 a 常为 /ə/，强调时可用 /eɪ/。
explanation.en: A often becomes /ə/. A strong form is /eɪ/.

prompt.zh: 弱读练习的目标是？
prompt.en: What is the goal of light speech?

explanation.zh: 弱读为信息组织服务，不是删光小词或无限加速。
explanation.en: Light speech helps key words stand out.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: banana 中间一拍最明显，首尾轻。
explanation.en: Listen for the strong middle beat in banana.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: I 是主语，want 表达想要，a cup 是一个杯子。
explanation.en: I is the subject. Want is the verb. A cup is the object.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: 轻读 a，同时让 want 与 cup 保持清楚。
explanation.en: Keep a light and make want and cup clear.

description.zh: 用音标、录音、词性和例句建立可靠的单词卡。
description.en: Use sound, meaning, and an example to check a word.

body.zh: 拼读规律帮助形成候选读法，无法保证任意新词都猜对。查词时选择 US 标签，核对音标、重音、录音；专有名词还可能需要本人或官方读法。
body.en: Spelling gives a possible sound, not a promise. Choose US audio and check stress. Names may need an official or personal source.

body.zh: 词典里的第一条释义不一定适用于当前句子。bank 在 bank account 中是银行，在 river bank 中是河岸；结合周围词和整句意思选择。
body.en: The first dictionary meaning may not fit. Bank can mean a money place or the side of a river. Use the words around it.

concepts.example: a river bank; a bank account
concepts.audioText: a river bank, a bank account

title.zh: 单词卡记录可复用信息

body.zh: 一张卡至少保留词、US 音标、当前词性、此处含义和短例句。再写一个个人易错点，如 one 以 /w/ 开头；复习时遮住答案主动回忆。
body.en: Save the word, US sounds, word type, meaning, and a short example. Add your own hard point. Hide the answer when you review.

prompt.zh: 怎样确认陌生词重音？
prompt.en: How can you check stress in a new word?

options: Stress the first part every time

explanation.zh: 词长和字母数不能可靠决定重音，音标与录音更直接。
explanation.en: US IPA and audio show stress directly.

prompt.zh: river bank 中 bank 指什么？
prompt.en: What does bank mean in river bank?

explanation.zh: river 给出语境，bank 在这里是河岸。
explanation.en: River gives the clue. This bank is beside water.

prompt.zh: one 的第一个音是？
prompt.en: What is the first sound in one?

explanation.zh: one 以辅音 /w/ 开头，字母 o 不代表首音一定是元音。
explanation.en: One starts with /w/, even though its first letter is o.
