explanation.zh: one 以 /w/ 起头，book 结尾 /k/。
explanation.en: Listen for /w/ in one and /k/ in book.

prompt.zh: 哪种卡片最有助于复用单词？
prompt.en: Which word card is most useful?

options: Sound, meaning, word type, and example
questions.answer: Sound, meaning, word type, and example

explanation.zh: 读音、词性、当前含义与语境一起记录，能减少机械背单个译词。
explanation.en: Sound and context help you use the word again.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: one 以 /w/ 起头；have 读 /hæv/，是 silent e 规律的例外。
explanation.en: Start one with w. Remember the vowel in have.

description.zh: 综合拼读线索、例外、重音与词典判断。
description.en: Use sound clues and check the whole word.

body.zh: 先找熟悉的字母组合，再尝试音节和重音，最后查美式词典。每一步都允许修正候选读法；“能确认”来自核实，而不是一次猜中。
body.en: Find familiar letter groups. Try the beats and stress. Then check US audio. Change your guess when the evidence differs.

body.zh: have/give/love、team/bread 是不同层面的线索与例外。按同一种易错点分组，比把所有词写成一长列更容易发现规律边界。
body.en: Group words by one hard point. Have and give challenge silent-e guessing. Team and bread show different ea sounds.

body.zh: 同一个词单读和在句中可能轻重不同。听到熟悉的音不完整时，先检查弱读和语境，不要立刻认为是另一个新词。
body.en: A word can sound lighter in a sentence. Listen for weak forms and use the meaning around them. The word may already be familiar.

prompt.zh: 哪对体现常见 silent e 元音变化？
prompt.en: Which pair shows the common silent-e change?

explanation.zh: kit 的 /ɪ/ 与 kite 的 /aɪ/ 对应常见 CVC/CVCe 模式。
explanation.en: Kit and kite follow the common pattern.

prompt.zh: ˈ 的作用是什么？

explanation.zh: 重音号放在重读音节前面。
explanation.en: The stress mark comes before the strong beat.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: bread 的 ea 读 /ɛ/，要与 /i/ 和 /aɪ/ 区分。
explanation.en: Bread has /ɛ/.

prompt.zh: 新词的含义怎样确认更可靠？
prompt.en: How can you check a new meaning?

options: Use one translation for every sentence
Match a dictionary meaning to the sentence
questions.answer: Match a dictionary meaning to the sentence

explanation.zh: 用当前句子选择适用义项，而不是套用唯一译词。
explanation.en: Choose the dictionary meaning that fits the sentence.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: to 引出目的地 school；自然说话时 to 常轻读。
explanation.en: To introduces the place. It can be light in speech.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: I have a book about food.
questions.answer: I have a book about food.

explanation.zh: have 是例外；about 后重；book /ʊ/ 与 food /u/ 形成对照。
explanation.en: Check have, the stress in about, and the two different vowels in book and food.

questions.audioText: I have a book about food.
questions.target: I have a book about food.

subtitle.zh: 由词素到词性，再把词放进完整句子。
subtitle.en: Learn word parts, word types, and simple sentences.

description.zh: 借助词素推测含义，保留验证这一步。
description.en: Use word parts to make a careful guess.

title.en: A start can give a clue

body.zh: un- 常表示否定，如 unhappy；re- 常表示再次，如 reread。但不是所有开头相同的词都含同一个前缀，uncle 不能拆成 un + cle。
body.en: Un- often means not, as in unhappy. Re- can mean again, as in reread. But uncle does not contain the same un- part.

title.en: An ending can give a clue

body.zh: -er 可表示做某事的人，如 teacher；-ness 常形成抽象名词，如 kindness。后缀帮助预测词性和含义，不保证唯一答案，例如 corner 不能理解为“做 corn 的人”。
body.en: Teacher ends in -er for a person. Kindness ends in -ness for a quality. Endings give clues, but they do not explain every word.

body.zh: raincoat 的两部分让人猜到“雨衣”；butterfly 却不是会飞的黄油。先给猜测加上“可能”，再用上下文和词典验证。
body.en: Raincoat is easy to guess from rain and coat. Butterfly is not flying butter. Treat a guess as a guess until you check.

prompt.zh: unhappy 最可能是什么意思？

explanation.zh: 这里 un- 表示否定，unhappy 是不开心的。
explanation.en: Un- means not in this word.

prompt.zh: reread 最可能表示什么？

explanation.zh: re- 在 reread 中表示再次。
explanation.en: Re- means again in reread.

prompt.zh: teacher 的 -er 提示什么？

explanation.zh: teach 是教，teacher 是教的人。
explanation.en: A teacher is a person who teaches.

prompt.zh: 哪个词不能按熟悉的 un- 否定前缀拆解？
prompt.en: Which word does not have un- meaning not?

explanation.zh: uncle 是一个整体词，不能拆成 un + cle 推意思。
explanation.en: Uncle is not built from un- meaning not.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: raincoat 由 rain 与 coat 组成，意思为雨衣。
explanation.en: A raincoat is a coat for rain.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: teacher 是人，kind 在本句描述人；词素线索还需放进句子。
explanation.en: Teacher names a person. Kind describes that person here.

description.zh: 问“是什么”和“做什么”，并认识一词多性。
description.en: Find things and actions in a sentence.

body.zh: 名词可指人、地方、东西或抽象概念，如 teacher、school、book、love。不能只用“看得见摸得着”判断名词；love 作“爱”这个概念时也是名词。
body.en: Nouns name people, places, things, and ideas. A noun can name an idea that you cannot touch, such as love.

body.zh: run、eat 表达动作，be、know、have 也可表达状态。找动词时问句子对主语说了什么，而不是只找明显的身体动作。
body.en: Run and eat are actions. Be, know, and have can show states. A verb says something about the subject.

body.zh: I read a book 中 book 是名词；I book a room 中 book 是动词“预订”。词性由句中作用和词典义项共同确认，不是一个单词永远只有一种标签。
body.en: Book names a thing in a book. It is an action in book a room. Use the sentence to choose the word type.

prompt.zh: 句中 book 的词性是什么？

explanation.zh: book 在这里表示所读的东西，是名词。
explanation.en: Book names the thing being read.

prompt.zh: 句中 book 的词性是什么？

explanation.zh: book 在这里表示预订这个动作。
explanation.en: Book means to reserve a room here.

prompt.zh: 哪个词是动词？

explanation.zh: know 表示认识这种状态，也属于动词。
explanation.en: Know is a state verb.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: have 是动词，a book 是名词短语。
explanation.en: Have is the verb. A book is a noun phrase.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: The teacher 是主语，reads 是动词，a book 是宾语。
explanation.en: The teacher is the subject, reads is the verb, and a book is the object.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: book 在此为动词。先理解整句“我预订房间”，再朗读。
explanation.en: Book is an action here. Say the whole sentence with its meaning.

description.zh: 区分描述名词与修饰动作，不迷信 -ly。
description.en: Describe a thing or say how an action happens.

body.zh: red、small、happy 是常见形容词，可放名词前，如 a red bag；也可放 be 后，如 The bag is red。它们描述事物的性质，不表示句子时态。
body.en: Adjectives describe things. They can come before a noun or after be. Red describes the bag in both examples.

concepts.example: a red bag; The bag is red.
concepts.translation: 一个红包；这个包是红色的。
concepts.audioText: a red bag, The bag is red.

body.zh: slowly、quickly 可说明动作怎样发生，如 She walks slowly。副词也可修饰形容词，如 very small；不要把它只理解为动词后的一类词。
body.en: An adverb can say how an action happens. Slowly describes walking. Very can make an adjective stronger.

title.zh: 后缀是线索，作用更重要

body.zh: 很多副词有 -ly，但 friendly 通常是形容词；fast 可以作形容词，也可以作副词。a fast car 描述车，She runs fast 描述跑的方式。
body.en: Many adverbs end in -ly, but friendly is usually an adjective. Fast can do both jobs. Read the whole sentence.

concepts.example: a fast car; She runs fast.
concepts.audioText: a fast car, She runs fast.

prompt.zh: red 在本句修饰哪个词？

explanation.zh: red 描述 bag 的颜色，是形容词。
explanation.en: Red describes the color of the bag.

prompt.zh: slowly 在本句是什么词？

explanation.zh: slowly 说明 walks 怎样发生，是副词。
explanation.en: Slowly says how she walks.

prompt.zh: 哪一句中的 fast 是副词？

explanation.zh: runs fast 中 fast 修饰跑这个动作。
explanation.en: Fast describes the action runs.

prompt.zh: friendly 一定是副词吗？
prompt.en: Is friendly an adverb just because of -ly?

explanation.zh: friendly 通常为形容词，描述友善的人或事。
explanation.en: Friendly is usually an adjective.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: small 放名词 cat 前，quickly 说明跑得快。
explanation.en: Small describes cat. Quickly describes runs.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: The red car is very fast.
questions.answer: The red car is very fast.

explanation.zh: red 与 fast 都描述 car；very 加强 fast。先抓 car、fast 等关键词。
explanation.en: Red and fast describe the car. Very adds strength to fast.

questions.audioText: The red car is very fast.
questions.target: The red car is very fast.

description.zh: 连接人物关系与位置，减少逐字硬译。
description.en: Show people, place, and simple relationships.

body.zh: I、you、he、she、it、we、they 常作主语；me、him、her、us、them 常作宾语。She knows him 中 she 发出认识这一状态，him 是被认识的人。
body.en: I, she, and they can be subjects. Me, her, and them can be objects. The form depends on the job in the sentence.

body.zh: in、on、under 常表示位置，后面接名词短语或代词。in the box 是在盒子里面，on the box 是在表面，under the box 是在下方。
body.en: In, on, and under can show place. A noun phrase often follows them. Small changes can change the meaning.

concepts.example: The book is on the desk.
concepts.audioText: The book is on the desk.

body.zh: 介词也可表达时间，如 on Monday、in June、at noon。中文同一个“在”可能对应不同介词，先按短语学习，再逐步总结适用范围。
body.en: Place words can also show time. Learn on Monday, in June, and at noon as useful phrases. One Chinese word may match several English words.

prompt.zh: 选择正确的宾语代词。

explanation.zh: knows 后面的宾语用 him，主语位置才常用 he。
explanation.en: Him is the object form after knows.

prompt.zh: 哪句表示书在桌子下面？
prompt.en: Which sentence puts the book below the desk?

options: The book is on the desk.
The book is under the desk.
The book is in the desk.
questions.answer: The book is under the desk.

explanation.zh: under 表示下方，on 表示在表面。
explanation.en: Under means below.

prompt.zh: Monday 前常用哪个介词？

explanation.zh: 具体星期几通常用 on，如 on Monday。
explanation.en: Use on for a day such as Monday.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: in 表示在内部，注意区分短小介词。
explanation.en: In means inside the box.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: She 为主语，me 为接收者宾语。
explanation.en: She is the subject. Me names the person who receives the book.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: The book is on the desk.
questions.answer: The book is on the desk.

explanation.zh: on the desk 构成位置短语；desk 的 /sk/ 不加额外元音。
explanation.en: Keep on the desk together. Do not add a vowel inside desk.

questions.audioText: The book is on the desk.
questions.target: The book is on the desk.

description.zh: 认识主语、动词、宾语与 be 结构。
description.en: Build clear sentences with a subject and verb.

body.zh: 普通陈述句常先说主语，再说动词，如 Birds fly。主语说明在谈谁或什么，动词说明动作或状态；不是每个句子都需要宾语。
body.en: A simple statement often starts with a subject and then a verb. Birds fly is complete. Not every verb needs an object.

body.zh: I read a book 中 I 为主语，read 为动词，a book 为宾语。英语一般不能按汉语语序随意放置这些成分，先用简单主谓宾练习。
body.en: I read a book has a subject, a verb, and an object. Start with this clear order. Other sentence types come later.

body.zh: The bag is red 里的 is 连接主语与描述；英语不能直接照汉语“包红色”省略它。be 随主语和时间变形，后面课程再追踪时态。
body.en: In The bag is red, is joins the thing and its description. Do not leave it out. Be changes with the subject and time.

prompt.zh: 哪个是完整陈述句？

explanation.zh: Birds 是主语，fly 是动词，这个句子不需要宾语也完整。
explanation.en: Birds is the subject and fly is the verb.

prompt.zh: 选择缺少的词。

explanation.zh: 描述状态时需要 be；bag 为单数，使用 is。
explanation.en: Use is to link the bag with red.

prompt.zh: 句中的宾语是什么？

explanation.zh: a book 是阅读动作指向的对象。
explanation.en: A book is the thing being read.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: fly 是动词，birds 是复数名词作主语。
explanation.en: Birds is a plural subject and fly is the verb.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: 先主语 My teacher，再动作 reads，最后宾语 a book。
explanation.en: Put the subject first, then the verb and object.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: small 在名词前修饰 bag；red 在 is 后描述 bag，is 不能省略。
explanation.en: Small and red both describe the bag. Keep is in the sentence.

description.zh: 结合语境，确认一个词在句中的工作。
description.en: Use the sentence to find meaning and word type.

body.zh: 同一词可有多种意思、多种词性；book 的两个用法就是例子。每次作答先理解整句，再给词分类，不要只靠汉语译词。
body.en: A word can have more than one meaning and job. Read the sentence first. Then name the job that fits.

concepts.example: I book a room. I read a book.
concepts.translation: 我预订房间。我读一本书。
concepts.audioText: I book a room. I read a book.

body.zh: un-、-er、-ly 等帮助筛选猜测，但都可能遇见看起来相似的不同结构。把词素、上下文、词典三类信息合起来判断。
body.en: Word parts can guide you but do not prove a meaning. Use the sentence and a dictionary to check.

body.zh: 掌握词性不只为做选择题。用新词写一条主语—动词—宾语句，再检查形容词、副词和介词是否放在正确位置。
body.en: Use a new word in your own sentence. Check the subject and verb first, then the describing words and place words.

prompt.zh: 这句中的 book 是什么词？
prompt.en: What is book in this sentence?

explanation.zh: book 表示预订，是句中的动词。
explanation.en: Book is the action of reserving a room.

prompt.zh: 哪一个词描述名词 teacher？

explanation.zh: kind 是形容词，说明老师友善。
explanation.en: Kind is an adjective describing the teacher.

prompt.zh: 仅凭 butterfly 两部分可以确认含义吗？
prompt.en: Can the two parts alone confirm butterfly?

explanation.zh: 合成词含义不一定等于两部分字面相加；butterfly 是蝴蝶。
explanation.en: A compound meaning is not always the sum of its parts.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: slowly 说明 walks 的方式，是副词。
explanation.en: Slowly describes how she walks.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

questions.answer: She puts the book on the desk.

explanation.zh: She 为主语，puts 为动词，the book 为宾语，on the desk 表示位置。
explanation.en: Build the subject, action, object, and place in that order.

questions.audioText: She puts the book on the desk.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: friendly 虽以 -ly 结尾，但在此是形容词；is 连接主语与描述。
explanation.en: Friendly is an adjective here. Is joins it to my teacher.

subtitle.zh: 看完整动词结构，理解现在、过去与先后关系。
subtitle.en: Read the full verb group to understand time.

title.zh: 一般现在时：习惯与状态

description.zh: 从日常习惯开始，认识第三人称和助动词。
description.en: Talk about habits and states.

body.zh: 一般现在时常表达习惯或稳定状态，如 I read every day、She knows me。它不自动表示“正在做”；正在发生的动作通常另用现在进行时。
body.en: The simple present often shows a habit or state. It does not always mean right now. I read every day is a habit.

title.en: He and she need a change

body.zh: he、she、it 或单数名词作主语时，普通动词常加 -s/-es，如 She reads。I、you、we、they 后用原形；be 单独记 am/is/are。
body.en: With he, she, it, or one person, most verbs add s or es. I, you, we, and they use the base form. Be has am, is, and are.

body.zh: 一般现在时普通动词的否定可用 do not/does not，疑问可用 Do/Does 开头。does 已带第三人称信息，后面的动词用原形：Does she read?
body.en: Use do or does to make many present questions and negatives. After does, use the base verb. Do not add s again.

concepts.example: Does she read? She does not read.
concepts.audioText: Does she read? She does not read.

prompt.zh: 选择正确形式。

explanation.zh: she 为第三人称单数，普通动词 read 加 -s。
explanation.en: She takes reads in the simple present.

prompt.zh: 这句主要表示什么？

questions.text: I walk to school every day.
options: An earlier past event · 更早过去

explanation.zh: every day 提示日常习惯，使用一般现在时。
explanation.en: Every day shows a regular habit.

prompt.zh: Does 后应填什么？

explanation.zh: does 承担第三人称形式，后接动词原形 read。
explanation.en: After does, use the base form read.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: reads every day 表示现在的习惯。
explanation.en: Reads every day describes a present habit.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

questions.answer: They do not read at night.

explanation.zh: they 使用 do not；read 保留原形。
explanation.en: Use do not with they, then the base verb read.

questions.audioText: They do not read at night.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: reads 结尾 /z/ 不要漏；这句用一般现在时表达习惯。
explanation.en: Keep the final z in reads. The sentence describes a habit.

title.zh: 一般过去时：完成的过去

description.zh: 规则变化、不规则动词与 did 后的原形。
description.en: Talk about a finished past time.

body.zh: 一般过去时常讲在过去某时发生的事，如 yesterday、last week。walk 变 walked；这里动词变化是整句时间结构的一部分，不是把所有 -ed 词都视为过去句。
body.en: Use the simple past for a finished past time. Walk becomes walked. A word ending in ed alone does not tell you the whole sentence structure.

body.zh: go→went、eat→ate、see→saw 不使用普通 -ed。把原形、过去式、过去分词连同例句记录；本课先练过去式，完成时再用过去分词。
body.en: Some past forms do not use ed: go becomes went and eat becomes ate. Save the forms with examples. Later, you will use past participles too.

body.zh: Did you go? 和 I did not go 中 did 已表示过去，后接 go，不用 went。be 的过去式 was/were 直接构成相应疑问否定，不再加 did。
body.en: Did already marks the past, so use go after it. Be is different: use was or were. Do not add did to was or were.

concepts.example: Did you go? I did not go.
concepts.audioText: Did you go? I did not go.

prompt.zh: 选择正确过去式。

explanation.zh: go 的过去式是不规则的 went。
explanation.en: Went is the past form of go.

prompt.zh: did 后应使用什么？

explanation.zh: did 后动词使用原形 read，这里读 /rid/。
explanation.en: After did, use base read, pronounced /rid/.

prompt.zh: 哪个句子正确？

explanation.zh: did not 后用原形 go，不能再次用过去式。
explanation.en: Use the base form after did not.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: went 是 go 的过去式。
explanation.en: Went marks the simple past of go.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: she 用 was，yesterday 是过去时间。
explanation.en: Use was with she for a past state.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: walked 的 -ed 读 /t/，本句有已结束的过去时间 yesterday。
explanation.en: Walked ends in /t/. Yesterday gives a finished past time.

description.zh: 用 be + ing 描述进行，用 will / going to 谈将来。
description.en: Say what is happening now and what comes later.

body.zh: 现在进行时由 am/is/are + 动词 -ing 构成。She is reading now 里的 is 不能省，只有 reading 这个词不能独立确认句子的时态。
body.en: The present continuous uses am, is, or are plus an ing form. Keep both parts. The word reading alone does not show a complete tense.

title.zh: 现在进行不适合所有状态

body.zh: know、believe、want 等状态动词在普通含义下通常用一般现在时，如 I know her。特殊语境有例外，初学时先用常见表达，不机械把 now 后都加 ing。
body.en: State verbs such as know usually use the simple present. Say I know her. Do not add ing to every verb just because the time is now.

title.zh: 谈将来的两种常见方式
title.en: Two ways to talk about later

body.zh: will + 原形可表达预测或当下决定；be going to + 原形常表达已有计划或根据迹象的预测。I will read tomorrow 与 I am going to read 都谈将来，will 不加 -s。
body.en: Will plus the base verb can show a prediction or a new decision. Be going to often shows a plan. Both can talk about the future.

concepts.example: I will read tomorrow. I am going to read.
concepts.translation: 我明天会读书。我打算读书。
concepts.audioText: I will read tomorrow. I am going to read.

prompt.zh: 哪句表示正在读？

explanation.zh: is + reading 构成现在进行时，now 补充当前语境。
explanation.en: Is reading is the present continuous.

prompt.zh: 现在进行时缺少哪个词？

explanation.zh: they 需要 are，are playing 构成进行结构。
explanation.en: They takes are. Are playing has both needed parts.

prompt.zh: will 后用哪个形式？

explanation.zh: will 后使用动词原形，不再加第三人称 -s。
explanation.en: Will is followed by the base verb read.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: am reading 表示现在进行；注意 am 不能省略。
explanation.en: Am reading is a present continuous verb group.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

questions.answer: I am going to read tomorrow.

explanation.zh: am going to 后接原形 read，表达将来计划。
explanation.en: Am going to plus read describes a plan.

questions.audioText: I am going to read tomorrow.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: is 可较轻但要保留；reading 的词尾为 /ŋ/，不用额外加 /ɡ/。
explanation.en: Keep is, even when it is light. Reading ends with /ŋ/.

title.zh: 现在完成时：过去连到现在

description.zh: 用 have/has + 过去分词说明现在相关的结果或经历。
description.en: Link an earlier action to the present.

body.zh: 现在完成时是 have/has + 过去分词，如 I have finished。这里 have 是助动词；I have a book 的 have 是实义动词“有”，并不是完成时。
body.en: The present perfect uses have or has plus a past participle. Have finished fits. Have a book does not: have means own there.

concepts.example: I have finished. I have a book.
concepts.translation: 我已经完成了。我有一本书。
concepts.audioText: I have finished. I have a book.

body.zh: I have lost my key 可强调现在找不到钥匙；I have visited Beijing 表示截至现在的经历。若明确讲 yesterday 等已结束的过去时段，一般用过去时。
body.en: I have lost my key can mean I cannot find it now. I have visited Beijing tells of experience up to now. Use the simple past with a finished time like yesterday.

title.zh: 过去式不总等于过去分词

body.zh: 规则动词的两种形式常相同，如 worked；不规则词可能不同，如 go/went/gone、eat/ate/eaten。现在完成时用 gone、eaten，不用 went、ate。
body.en: Regular verbs often use the same past form and participle. Some do not: go, went, gone. After have or has, use the participle.

prompt.zh: 哪个是现在完成时？

explanation.zh: have + 过去分词 read 构成现在完成时，这里的 read 读 /rɛd/。
explanation.en: Have plus past participle read forms the present perfect.

prompt.zh: 填入正确过去分词。

explanation.zh: has 后需过去分词 eaten，ate 是过去式。
explanation.en: After has, use eaten. Ate is the simple past form.

prompt.zh: 带 yesterday 的普通完成事件通常选哪句？
prompt.en: Which sentence fits a finished event yesterday?

explanation.zh: yesterday 是明确已结束的过去时间，普通表达用一般过去时。
explanation.en: A finished time like yesterday normally takes the simple past.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: has eaten 是完成结构，eaten 是过去分词。
explanation.en: Has eaten uses has plus a past participle.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: have lost 把过去丢钥匙的事件与当前情况连接。
explanation.en: Have lost connects the earlier loss to now.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: have finished 是完整动词组；finished 的词尾读 /t/，不另加一音节。
explanation.en: Keep have and finished together. Finished ends with /t/.

description.zh: 用 had + 过去分词表达两个过去事件的先后。
description.en: Show an event before another past point.

body.zh: 过去完成时由 had + 过去分词构成。When I arrived, she had left 表示我到达是过去的参照点，她离开在那之前；不是“很久以前”就必须用它。
body.en: The past perfect uses had plus a participle. It looks back from a past point. It does not simply mean a very long time ago.

concepts.example: When I arrived, she had left.
concepts.audioText: When I arrived, she had left.

title.zh: 先后关系比词尾更关键

body.zh: 在 She had eaten before I came 中，吃发生在来之前。先在脑中排出事件顺序，再选择结构；如果只是依次叙述，很多场合一般过去时已足够。
body.en: In She had eaten before I came, eating happens first. Work out the order before choosing the form. A simple past story often does not need the past perfect.

concepts.example: She had eaten before I came.
concepts.translation: 我来之前，她已经吃过了。
concepts.audioText: She had eaten before I came.

title.zh: had 不一定表示完成时
title.en: Had has more than one job

body.zh: I had a bike 的 had 是 have 的过去式，后面是名词，并非过去完成时。I had finished 才有 had + 过去分词；识别时必须看整个动词结构。
body.en: In I had a bike, had means owned. It is simple past. In I had finished, had helps make the past perfect. Read what follows it.

concepts.example: I had a bike. I had finished.
concepts.translation: 我以前有辆自行车。我那时已经完成了。
concepts.audioText: I had a bike. I had finished.

prompt.zh: 这句哪个动作先发生？

questions.text: When I arrived, she had left.

explanation.zh: had left 表示离开发生在过去的 arrived 之前。
explanation.en: Had left happened before the past point arrived.

prompt.zh: 哪个是过去完成时？

explanation.zh: had + finished 构成过去完成时。
explanation.en: Had plus finished forms the past perfect.

prompt.zh: had 后应填哪种形式？

explanation.zh: 完成结构需要过去分词 eaten。
explanation.en: A perfect form needs the participle eaten.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: had left 是过去完成，has left 是现在完成，注意助动词。
explanation.en: Listen to had. It differs from has and will.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

questions.answer: She had eaten before I came.

explanation.zh: had eaten 先发生，I came 后发生。
explanation.en: Eating happened before I came.

questions.audioText: She had eaten before I came.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: When I arrived, she had left.
questions.answer: When I arrived, she had left.

explanation.zh: 在逗号处可轻停；had left 保留助动词，以表达过去的先后关系。
explanation.en: Pause lightly at the comma. Keep had to show the earlier past event.

questions.audioText: When I arrived, she had left.
questions.target: When I arrived, she had left.

description.zh: 比较六种常见结构，不靠单个词尾下结论。
description.en: Compare six useful time patterns.

body.zh: reads、read yesterday、will read、is reading、has read、had read 表达不同结构。reading 或 read 单独出现不足以判定整句时态，必须结合助动词与语境。
body.en: Find all parts of the verb group. Is reading and has read do different jobs. One word on its own may not show the tense.

concepts.example: She reads. She is reading. She has read.
concepts.translation: 她常读书。她正在读。她已经读过。
concepts.audioText: She reads. She is reading. She has read.

body.zh: every day 常提示习惯，now 可支持进行，yesterday 常提供已结束过去。完成时更重视从“现在”或“过去某点”回看，但时间词也不是单独的万能判据。
body.en: Time words help: every day, now, yesterday. Perfect forms look back from now or a past point. Use both time and grammar clues.

concepts.example: I read every day. I read yesterday.
concepts.translation: 我每天读书。我昨天读了书。
concepts.audioText: I read every day. I read yesterday.

body.zh: book 可以是名词或动词，这是词性问题；has booked 是现在完成结构，这是时态与体的问题。名词没有“现在进行时”，完整句中的动词组才承担这些信息。
body.en: Book can be a noun or verb: that is its word type. Has booked is a present perfect form. Nouns do not have a continuous tense.

prompt.zh: 这句是什么结构？

explanation.zh: is + reading 构成现在进行时。
explanation.en: Is plus an ing form makes the present continuous.

prompt.zh: 哪句表示一般过去？

options: I had eaten before he came.

explanation.zh: ate 是过去式，yesterday 提供已结束的过去时间。
explanation.en: Ate with yesterday describes a finished past event.

prompt.zh: 哪句说明比“我到达”更早的过去？
prompt.en: Which sentence shows an event before my arrival?

options: She had left when I arrived.
questions.answer: She had left when I arrived.

explanation.zh: had left 明确从过去参照点 arrived 往前看。
explanation.en: Had left looks back from the time I arrived.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: will + read 谈将来，tomorrow 支持将来语境。
explanation.en: Will plus read talks about tomorrow.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: booked 在 has 后是过去分词；整组 has booked 为现在完成时。
explanation.en: Has booked is a present perfect verb group.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: have + finished 表示现在完成；不要把 have 当作“有”逐字翻译。
explanation.en: Have helps form the present perfect here. It does not mean own.

subtitle.zh: 先判断可数性，再选冠词、复数与词尾读音。
subtitle.en: Choose articles, plurals, and ending sounds.

description.zh: 认识单数可数与不可数，避免机械在名词前加 a。
description.en: Check if the noun can be counted.

body.zh: book、apple 可用 one、two 直接数，属于可数名词；water、rice 在表示物质时通常不可数。不确定就查词典 [C]、[U] 标记，不能按中文有没有“一个”判断。
body.en: You can count one book or two apples. Water and rice are usually uncountable as materials. A dictionary can show C or U.

title.en: When to use a or an

body.zh: a/an 用于单数可数名词，如 a book、an apple。泛指复数或不可数名词时不直接加 a/an；可说 books、some water。它们是冠词，不是形容词。
body.en: Use a or an with one countable thing. Do not put a directly before plural books or uncountable water. A and an are articles.

body.zh: 要数水，可以说 a cup of water、two cups of water。这里数的是 cup，water 仍表示物质；有些词换义项后可数性会变，要结合语境。
body.en: To count water, use a unit: a cup of water. The cup is countable. A word may become countable in a different meaning, so check the context.

prompt.zh: 哪一个可以直接用 one 来数？
prompt.en: Which can follow one directly in this meaning?

explanation.zh: book 表示一本书，可直接数；water、rice 表示物质时通常不可数。
explanation.en: Book is countable. Water and rice as materials are not.

prompt.zh: 选择正确表达。

explanation.zh: 表示一些水时用 some water；a cup of water 是另一种计量表达。
explanation.en: Use some water for an amount of water.

prompt.zh: a/an 属于什么？
prompt.en: What kind of words are a and an?

explanation.zh: a/an 是不定冠词，出现在名词短语中。
explanation.en: A and an are indefinite articles.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: a cup 是一个可数单位，of water 指杯中的内容。
explanation.en: A cup is a countable unit for water.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: want 后接 some water，不直接用 a water 表示普通物质。
explanation.en: Some water is a natural phrase for an amount of water.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: I want a cup of water.
questions.answer: I want a cup of water.

explanation.zh: 数的是 cup，water 本身仍是物质；of 和 a 可轻读。
explanation.en: Count the cup, not the water. Keep a and of light.

questions.audioText: I want a cup of water.
questions.target: I want a cup of water.

description.zh: 听紧随冠词的声音，处理 hour、university 与形容词。
description.en: Listen to the next sound, not just the first letter.

body.zh: 紧接冠词的词以元音音素起头用 an，以辅音音素起头用 a。an apple、a book 都符合；判断对象是声音，不是 a e i o u 这五个字母。
body.en: Use an before a vowel sound and a before a consonant sound. Listen to the next word. Letters alone are not enough.

title.zh: 看见元音字母也可能用 a

body.zh: university 以辅音 /j/ 起头，所以 a university；hour 的 h 不发音，以 /aʊ/ 起头，所以 an hour。one 以 /w/ 起头，因此 a one-day trip。
body.en: University starts with /j/, so use a. Hour starts with a vowel, so use an. One starts with /w/, so use a one-day trip.

concepts.example: a university; an hour; a one-day trip
concepts.translation: 一所大学；一小时；一日游
concepts.audioText: a university, an hour, a one-day trip

title.zh: 形容词改变紧邻的声音

body.zh: a book 前加入 old，变成 an old book；an apple 前加入 red，变成 a red apple。冠词与名词中间有词时，仍听紧接冠词的第一个声音。
body.en: An adjective can change the next sound: an old book, but a red apple. Listen to the word right after the article.

concepts.example: an old book; a red apple
concepts.audioText: an old book, a red apple

prompt.zh: 填 a 还是 an？

explanation.zh: hour 首音是 /aʊ/，h 不发音，因此用 an。
explanation.en: Hour starts with a vowel sound.

prompt.zh: 填 a 还是 an？

explanation.zh: university 首音是辅音 /j/，因此用 a。
explanation.en: University starts with the consonant /j/.

prompt.zh: 选择正确短语。

explanation.zh: 紧接冠词的是 old，其首音为元音 /oʊ/。
explanation.en: Old starts with a vowel sound, so use an.

prompt.zh: 选择正确短语。

explanation.zh: 紧接冠词的是 red 的 /r/，而不是 apple 的元音。
explanation.en: The next sound is r in red, so use a.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: hour 无 /h/，a/an 选择遵循实际读音。
explanation.en: Hour starts with a vowel, with no h sound.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: an 接 old 的元音，old 再修饰 book。把整段 an old book 连贯地读。
explanation.en: Use an before old and keep the noun phrase together.

description.zh: 从 -s、-es 到 -ies，把拼写规则分层处理。
description.en: Add s, es, or ies to make common plurals.

title.zh: 多数加 s，嘶擦音后常加 es

body.zh: 多数可数名词加 -s，如 book→books。以 s、sh、ch、x 等常见嘶擦音拼写结尾的词通常加 -es，如 bus→buses、box→boxes；原词末尾已有 e 常只加 s，如 face→faces。
body.en: Most count nouns add s. Bus and box add es. If the word already ends in e, often add only s, as in faces.

title.zh: 先看 y 前面的字母

body.zh: 辅音字母加 y 结尾通常把 y 变 i 再加 es，如 baby→babies。元音字母加 y 时通常直接加 s，如 boy→boys；不要见 y 就改写。
body.en: After a consonant letter, y usually becomes ies: babies. After a vowel letter, keep y and add s: boys.

concepts.translation: 婴儿、婴儿们；男孩、男孩们

title.zh: o 与 f 类需要查词

body.zh: tomato→tomatoes，但 photo→photos；leaf→leaves，但 roof→roofs。它们有规律分组也有例外，词典复数栏比“统一加 es 或 ves”可靠。
body.en: Some o words add es, but photos adds s. Leaf becomes leaves, but roof becomes roofs. Check these words individually.

concepts.translation: 番茄、照片、叶子、屋顶（复数）

prompt.zh: box 的复数是什么？
prompt.en: What is the plural of box?

explanation.zh: box 以 /ks/ 结尾，常规复数拼写为 boxes。
explanation.en: Box adds es to make boxes.

prompt.zh: baby 的复数是什么？
prompt.en: What is the plural of baby?

explanation.zh: 辅音字母 b + y，变 y 为 i 加 es。
explanation.en: A consonant before y gives babies.

prompt.zh: boy 的复数是什么？
prompt.en: What is the plural of boy?

explanation.zh: y 前是元音字母 o，保留 y 加 s。
explanation.en: Keep y after a vowel letter and add s.

prompt.zh: 哪个复数正确？

explanation.zh: photo 是常见加 s 的 o 结尾词。
explanation.en: Photo adds s: photos.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: boxes 常有额外 /ɪz/ 音节；本课先把拼写与声音一起记。
explanation.en: Boxes has an extra ending beat.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: I have two boxes and three books.
questions.answer: I have two boxes and three books.

explanation.zh: boxes 词尾是 /ɪz/，books 是 /s/；复数数量不止写在纸上，也要读出线索。
explanation.en: Boxes ends in /ɪz/. Books ends in /s/. Keep both endings clear.

questions.audioText: I have two boxes and three books.
questions.target: I have two boxes and three books.

description.zh: 学常见不规则形式，也留心不可数与同形词。
description.en: Learn useful plurals that do not just add s.

body.zh: child→children、person→people、man→men、woman→women 是高频不规则形式。按一对一组记；people 通常表示多人，但特殊“民族”义项可有 peoples。
body.en: Child becomes children and person commonly becomes people. Man and woman change their vowels. Learn each pair with a short phrase.

body.zh: sheep、deer 的常见单复数拼写相同。one sheep 与 three sheep 用数字和整句判断数量，不再加 s；fish 也常同形，fishes 可有物种等语境。
body.en: Sheep and deer often keep the same form. Use one sheep or three sheep. The number helps show the meaning.

title.zh: 别给不可数名词乱加 s

body.zh: information、advice 在通常含义下不可数，常说 some information、a piece of advice。中文可数方式不能直接决定英语复数，要把可数性记录进词卡。
body.en: Information and advice are usually uncountable. Say some information or a piece of advice. Save this detail on your word card.

concepts.example: some information; a piece of advice
concepts.audioText: some information, a piece of advice

prompt.zh: child 的复数是什么？
prompt.en: What is the plural of child?

explanation.zh: child 的不规则复数为 children。
explanation.en: Children is the irregular plural of child.

prompt.zh: woman 的复数是什么？
prompt.en: What is the plural of woman?

explanation.zh: women 是复数，元音也变化，需连录音一起学。
explanation.en: Women is the plural and its vowel changes too.

prompt.zh: 选择正确表达。

explanation.zh: sheep 的常用复数与单数同形。
explanation.en: Sheep keeps the same form in the plural.

prompt.zh: 选择通常正确的表达。

explanation.zh: information 通常不可数，可说 some information。
explanation.en: Information is usually uncountable.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: children 是 child 的不规则复数。
explanation.en: Children is the plural of child.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: children 与 sheep 都不能机械加 s；sheep 用 /i/，不是 ship 的 /ɪ/。
explanation.en: Use children and sheep without extra s. Keep /i/ in sheep.

title.zh: s 与 ed 的三种声音

description.zh: 听词干末音，决定 /s z ɪz/ 与 /t d ɪd/。
description.en: Use the last sound to choose an ending sound.

body.zh: 名词复数或动词第三人称的 -s，接在 /s z ʃ ʒ tʃ dʒ/ 后通常读 /ɪz/ 或接近 /əz/，多一个音节，如 buses、watches。判断看原词末音，不只看末字母。
body.en: After /s z ʃ ʒ tʃ dʒ/, the s ending adds a beat, often /ɪz/. Buses and watches show this. Listen to the last sound of the base word.

concepts.translation: 公交车们、手表们/观看（第三人称）

body.zh: 非嘶擦清辅音后通常 /s/，如 cats、books；其他浊音和元音后通常 /z/，如 dogs、boys。这同样适用于许多第三人称词尾，但要留心 says、does 等整词例外。
body.en: After other voiceless sounds, use /s/: cats. After vowels and other voiced sounds, use /z/: dogs, boys. Some whole words have extra changes.

title.zh: ed 只在 t/d 后加一拍

body.zh: 规则动词 -ed 在 /t d/ 后读 /ɪd/，如 wanted、needed；其他清音后读 /t/，如 walked；其他浊音和元音后读 /d/，如 played。部分形容词需另查，如 naked 常读 /ˈneɪkɪd/，不能直接套规则动词的读法。
body.en: For regular verbs, ed adds a beat after t or d: wanted, needed. After other quiet sounds use /t/. After other voiced sounds use /d/. Some adjectives are exceptions.

prompt.zh: books 的词尾怎么读？
prompt.en: How does the ending of books sound?

explanation.zh: book 末音 /k/ 是非嘶擦清辅音，所以加 /s/。
explanation.en: K is voiceless, so the ending is /s/.

prompt.zh: dogs 的词尾怎么读？
prompt.en: How does the ending of dogs sound?

explanation.zh: dog 末音 /ɡ/ 为浊音，所以词尾 /z/。
explanation.en: G is voiced, so the ending is /z/.

prompt.zh: 哪个词的 ed 多一个音节？
prompt.en: Which ed ending adds a beat?

explanation.zh: want 末音 /t/，所以 wanted 末尾 /ɪd/。
explanation.en: Want ends in t, so wanted adds /ɪd/.

prompt.zh: played 的 ed 怎么读？
prompt.en: How does ed sound in played?

explanation.zh: play 以元音 /eɪ/ 结尾，ed 读 /d/，不另加音节。
explanation.en: Play ends in a vowel, so ed is /d/.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: wanted 的 /ɪd/ 多一音节，注意不是所有 ed 都如此。
explanation.en: Wanted adds a beat after t.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: wanted 末尾 /ɪd/；books 末尾 /s/。把两种规则都应用到句中。
explanation.en: Wanted adds /ɪd/. Books ends in /s/.

description.zh: 按可数性、紧邻声音、拼写与词尾依次判断。
description.en: Check counting, starting sounds, and ending sounds.

body.zh: 先确认这里是否需要一个单数可数名词短语，再听紧邻冠词的声音。a university 与 an hour 说明字母不是最终标准；a/an 也不能直接配复数。
body.en: First check if you need one countable thing. Then listen to the next sound. Do not use a or an directly with a plural noun.

title.zh: 复数分开看写法与读法

body.zh: babies 的写法来自辅音+y 规则，末尾 /z/ 来自 baby 的末音为元音。boxes 的写法是 -es，读法额外一拍；拼写规则和发音规则互相配合但不是同一件事。
body.en: Babies uses the y spelling rule but ends in /z/ because baby ends in a vowel sound. Boxes adds both letters and a beat. Check spelling and sound separately.

body.zh: 如果 an university 选错，记录“看字母代替听 /j/”；如果 wanted 少一拍，记录“/t/ 后 ed 加一拍”。复习针对原因重新判断，比只抄正确答案更有效。
body.en: Save why an answer was wrong. Was it the first sound, the spelling, or the final sound? Practice that one decision again.

prompt.zh: 选择正确冠词。

explanation.zh: 紧邻冠词的是 red 的辅音 /r/，用 a。
explanation.en: Red starts with r, so use a.

prompt.zh: 选择正确复数。

explanation.zh: 辅音字母+y 变 -ies。
explanation.en: A consonant before y gives ies.

prompt.zh: 选择正确表达。

explanation.zh: children 已经是复数，不再加 s。
explanation.en: Children is already plural.

prompt.zh: walked 的 ed 发什么音？
prompt.en: What sound does ed make in walked?

explanation.zh: walk 末音 /k/ 为清音且不是 /t/，ed 为 /t/。
explanation.en: Walk ends in k, so ed is /t/ without an extra beat.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: watches 末尾 /ɪz/ 增加一拍，来自 watch 的 /tʃ/。
explanation.en: Watch ends in /tʃ/, so the plural adds a beat.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: I have an old book and two new books.
questions.answer: I have an old book and two new books.

explanation.zh: an 看 old 的元音；books 用复数 /s/；new 在 book 前描述新旧。
explanation.en: Use an before old. Keep /s/ at the end of books.

questions.audioText: I have an old book and two new books.
questions.target: I have an old book and two new books.

subtitle.zh: 从词界到信息焦点，把难点变成可复练的个人册子。
subtitle.en: Join words and build a review book that helps you.

title.en: Join a last and first sound

description.zh: 把两个熟词连起来，保留词义与词尾。
description.en: Join words smoothly across a word boundary.

body.zh: 词尾辅音遇到下词开头元音时，常平滑衔接，如 an apple、pick it up。拼写仍分词，发音动作可以连续；不是额外创造一个新音。
body.en: A final consonant can flow into the next vowel. An apple and pick it up show this. The words stay separate in writing.

body.zh: 先清楚说出 take 与 it，再把 /k/ 释放到 it 的元音。不要把连读理解为删除 take 的尾音；先慢后快，自然速度仍以可懂为准。
body.en: Say take and it clearly first. Then release k into the vowel in it. Linking does not mean removing the final sound.

body.zh: 句中短意群内部常连贯，逗号或意义边界处可以停顿。比较 After lunch, I read：在 lunch 后停一下很自然，不必把所有相邻词强制连接。
body.en: Words often link inside a short meaning group. You may pause at a boundary. Do not force every pair of words to join.

prompt.zh: 哪个位置适合练辅音接元音连读？
prompt.en: Which pair joins a consonant to a vowel?

explanation.zh: an 末尾 /n/ 接 apple 首元音 /æ/，适合平滑连接。
explanation.en: The final n can move into the first vowel of apple.

prompt.zh: take it 连读时怎样处理 /k/？
prompt.en: What happens to k when you join take it?

options: Release it into the next vowel
questions.answer: Release it into the next vowel

explanation.zh: 保留 /k/ 动作并向下词元音释放，不随意删掉。
explanation.en: Keep k and move smoothly into the next vowel.

prompt.zh: 哪里适合轻停？
prompt.en: Where can you make a light pause?

explanation.zh: 逗号对应一个自然意群边界，可以轻停。
explanation.en: The comma marks a natural meaning boundary.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: it 两边都可平滑连接；听整体词组而不是只找每词停顿。
explanation.en: Listen to the whole phrase. The words may flow together.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: an 与 apple 是可连接的名词短语，Can I 也常连贯。
explanation.en: An apple can link smoothly. Can I can also flow together.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: 先保证每个词清楚，再尝试 have‿an、an‿apple 的辅音—元音衔接。
explanation.en: First keep the words clear. Then join have an and an apple.

description.zh: 用突出信息组织语流，认识常见弱读与口语缩减。
description.en: Make key words clear and small words light.

body.zh: 普通句中名词、主要动词、形容词常较突出，冠词与助动词常较轻。但焦点随语境变：I want the BLUE one 强调颜色，不是每句只有一种重音。
body.en: Nouns, main verbs, and describing words often stand out. Small words are often light. The focus can change with the message.

body.zh: can 在非强调位置可近 /kən/，to 可近 /tə/，and 可近 /ən/。知道这些读法有助于把语流还原成词；强调、澄清时可用更完整的形式。
body.en: Can, to, and and often have light forms. Learn them for listening. A clear strong form is useful when you stress or explain a word.

concepts.example: I can go to the store.
concepts.audioText: I can go to the store.

title.zh: 口语缩减不等于正式拼写

body.zh: want to 在随意口语中可能近 wanna；going to 表将来时可能近 gonna。先学识别，不强制模仿；正式写作保留标准形式，且 I am going to school 的目的地结构不能机械替换为 gonna school。
body.en: You may hear wanna or gonna in casual talk. Learn to recognize them first. Keep standard forms in formal writing. Going to a place is not the same pattern.

concepts.example: I want to go. I am going to school.
concepts.audioText: I want to go. I am going to school.

prompt.zh: 想强调颜色，应突出哪个词？
prompt.en: Which word should stand out to show the color?

explanation.zh: 对比颜色时突出 blue，焦点由意思决定。
explanation.en: Blue carries the color contrast.

prompt.zh: can 的常见弱读是哪一个？
prompt.en: Which is a common light form of can?

explanation.zh: can 不强调时可弱读为 /kən/，强调时常用 /kæn/。
explanation.en: Can often becomes /kən/ when it is not stressed.

prompt.zh: 哪种写法适合正式作业？
prompt.en: Which form fits formal school writing?

explanation.zh: want to 是标准写法；wanna 多用于表现随意口语。
explanation.en: Want to is the standard form for formal writing.

prompt.zh: gonna 可以机械替换哪句话里的 going to 吗？
prompt.en: Can gonna replace going to in this sentence?

explanation.zh: 这里 to school 表示目的地，不是 going to + 动词原形的将来结构。
explanation.en: To school names a place, not a future verb.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

options: I can go to the store.
I cannot go to the store.
questions.answer: I can go to the store.

explanation.zh: 听 can、to 的轻重，再用整句确认，不凭一个模糊元音断定否定。
explanation.en: Listen to the full phrase and its meaning, not just one light vowel.

questions.audioText: I can go to the store.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: 把 blue 作为信息焦点，the 可以较轻；不需要把整句读得很快。
explanation.en: Make blue stand out. Keep the light words clear enough to follow.

title.zh: 词尾不爆破与美式轻拍
title.en: Quiet stops and the US tap

description.zh: 认识自然变体，避免把轻拍读成完全不同的音位。
description.en: Hear quiet stop endings and a common US t sound.

title.zh: 做了动作，未必有爆破声

body.zh: 在 good day、black bag 等组合里，前一个塞音可保持闭合而不明显释放。常说“失去爆破”，但这不等于完全没有发音动作；初学先保留清晰闭合。
body.en: In good day or black bag, the first stop may have no clear release. The closure can still be there. Learn the mouth movement before speeding up.

title.zh: 美式 t/d 的轻拍变体

body.zh: water、city、better 中的 t，在常见美式读法里可用快速舌尖轻拍 [ɾ]，尤其在重读元音后、非重读元音前。它听起来接近很轻的 d，但不应改写为字母 d，也不适用于每个 t。
body.en: In words such as city and better, US t can be a quick tongue tap. It often comes after a strong vowel and before a weak one. It is not a rule for every t.

title.zh: 接受清晰和自然两种速度

body.zh: 慢速教学音与自然语流不一定完全相同。能识别轻拍和不明显释放即可；清晰的 /t/ 也不必自动视为错，目标是口音一致且容易理解。
body.en: Slow teaching speech and natural speech can differ. Learn to hear the tap and quiet stops. A clear t can still be understandable.

prompt.zh: 不明显爆破通常意味着什么？
prompt.en: What can a quiet stop mean?

options: A closure with little or no release
questions.answer: A closure with little or no release

explanation.zh: 前一个塞音可有闭合而无明显释放，不等于随意删音。
explanation.en: The closure can remain even without a clear burst.

prompt.zh: 哪个词常有美式轻拍 t？
prompt.en: Which word often has a US tap?

explanation.zh: city 的 t 位于常见轻拍环境；stop、top 的首音环境不同。
explanation.en: City has a common tap position between a strong and weak beat.

prompt.zh: 轻拍是否让 water 必须拼成 wader？
prompt.en: Does the tap change the spelling of water to wader?

explanation.zh: 这是发音变体，water 的拼写不因此改变。
explanation.en: A sound variant does not change the spelling.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: 美式 city 中 t 可能很轻；结合完整单词识别。
explanation.en: The t in US city can be a quick tap.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

explanation.zh: black bag 中 /k b/ 相邻，/k/ 可无明显爆破但保留闭合动作。
explanation.en: K and b meet across the word boundary. The k release may be quiet.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

explanation.zh: better 中可尝试轻拍；先清楚说出词，再模仿自然示范，不强迫舌头用力。
explanation.en: Say better clearly first. Try a gentle quick tap if it feels comfortable.

description.zh: 了解自然语流变化的条件，不把随意口语当唯一标准。
description.en: Hear changes in casual speech without forcing them.

title.en: Nearby sounds can help each other

body.zh: ten bikes 中 /n/ 在快语速下可受后面的 /b/ 影响而接近 /m/，使口腔动作更连续。此类同化与语速、说话人相关，不是每次都必须发生。
body.en: In fast ten bikes, n may move toward m before b. Nearby sounds can change mouth movements. Speakers and speeds differ.

body.zh: did you、would you 的 /d + j/ 在自然口语中常出现接近 /dʒ/ 的衔接。保持两个词的意思，先听懂这种融合；清晰慢读时分开也正常。
body.en: In did you or would you, d and y may blend toward a j sound. Learn to hear this. A careful separate form is also normal.

concepts.example: Did you go? Would you like tea?
concepts.audioText: Did you go? Would you like tea?

body.zh: next day 中 /t/ 在复杂辅音群里可能不明显甚至略去。学习顺序应是清晰词形→听懂自然变体→在合适场景尝试；不能把漏掉重要词尾都解释成连读。
body.en: In next day, t may be very light or absent in a cluster. Learn the clear word first. Do not use this as a reason to drop any ending.

prompt.zh: ten bikes 中什么音可能受到 /b/ 影响？
prompt.en: Which sound may change before b in ten bikes?

explanation.zh: /n/ 的部位可能向双唇靠拢，接近 /m/。
explanation.en: N may move toward a lip sound like m.

prompt.zh: did you 中 /d+j/ 可能接近哪个音？
prompt.en: What may d plus y approach in did you?

explanation.zh: 自然语流中可能发生靠拢融合，接近 /dʒ/。
explanation.en: The two sounds may blend toward /dʒ/.

prompt.zh: 同化应该怎样练？
prompt.en: How should you practice these sound changes?

options: Hear it first, then try it in context
questions.answer: Hear it first, then try it in context

explanation.zh: 先理解和听辨，再按语速与场景选择自然变体。
explanation.en: Learn to hear it first. Use it only where it fits.

prompt.zh: next day 的 t 不明显，说明什么？
prompt.en: What may a light t in next day show?

options: A possible change in a sound group
questions.answer: A possible change in a sound group

explanation.zh: 这是辅音群中的自然变体，不推广到所有 t，也不改变拼写。
explanation.en: This can happen in a cluster. It does not change the spelling.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: 即使 did you 衔接紧密，也要听出过去助动词 did。
explanation.en: Even when the words blend, did still marks the past question.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: Would you like a cup of tea?
questions.answer: Would you like a cup of tea?

explanation.zh: would you 可以清晰分读或自然融合；保持整体可懂，cup of 也可平滑连接。
explanation.en: Keep the question clear. You may join would you and cup of smoothly.

questions.audioText: Would you like a cup of tea?
questions.target: Would you like a cup of tea?

description.zh: 整理自己的词、错误原因与下一次复练。
description.en: Save useful words and practice the hard part again.

title.zh: 错误要具体到可练动作

body.zh: 不要只写“发音不好”。可以写“ship 误读成 sheep”“books 漏 /s/”“an university 只看字母”；具体标签能指向下一次练习。
body.en: Do not write only bad pronunciation. Save one clear problem: ship versus sheep, a missing s, or the first sound in university.

body.zh: 复习先遮住释义、音标或答案，尝试回忆；再听示范或打开解析纠正。答对一次不代表长期掌握，隔一段时间再试，比连续机械抄写更能检查记忆。
body.en: Hide the answer and try to remember first. Then listen or read the reason. Try again later to check what you still remember.

title.en: Use it in a new sentence

body.zh: 单词册保存你自己的短句和具体语境。录音先与示范逐项比：目标元音、词尾、重音；自动识别出文字不等于精确测出舌位或每个音的质量。
body.en: Save your own short example. Compare one vowel, ending, or stress point at a time. Speech-to-text can show words, but it cannot fully measure your mouth movement.

concepts.example: I read a new book every week.
concepts.audioText: I read a new book every week.

prompt.zh: 哪个错误记录最便于复练？
prompt.en: Which note helps you practice again?

options: I used /i/ in ship instead of /ɪ/
questions.answer: I used /i/ in ship instead of /ɪ/

explanation.zh: 它指明具体目标音和替代音，可用 ship/sheep 对照重练。
explanation.en: It names one clear sound pair to practice.

prompt.zh: 复习时应先做什么？
prompt.en: What should you do first in review?

options: Try to remember without the answer
Copy the same answer ten times
questions.answer: Try to remember without the answer

explanation.zh: 先主动回忆，再看答案与解析，可以发现真实的记忆缺口。
explanation.en: Trying first shows what you can remember.

prompt.zh: 语音识别文字正确，能证明每个音都准确吗？
prompt.en: Does correct speech-to-text prove every sound is right?

explanation.zh: 识别正确只是词被识别的信号，不能等同音素级发音测量。
explanation.en: Word recognition is not a full sound-by-sound assessment.

prompt.zh: 答对一次后，下一步更合适的是？
prompt.en: What helps after one correct answer?

options: Try it again later in a new sentence
questions.answer: Try it again later in a new sentence

explanation.zh: 间隔复习与新句迁移能检查记忆是否稳定。
explanation.en: Later practice and a new example help check lasting memory.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

questions.answer: I read a new book every week.

explanation.zh: every week 提示习惯，read 为一般现在时；new 修饰 book。
explanation.en: Every week shows a habit. New describes book.

questions.audioText: I read a new book every week.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: I read a new book every week.
questions.answer: I read a new book every week.

explanation.zh: 现在习惯 read 用 /rid/；把 books 等其他练习的错误原因迁移检查到这句。
explanation.en: Use present read, /rid/. Check one personal hard point as you speak.

questions.audioText: I read a new book every week.
questions.target: I read a new book every week.

description.zh: 把读音、意思、语法与自然语流用于新句。
description.en: Bring sounds, meaning, grammar, and smooth speech together.

body.zh: 先看这句话表达谁、做什么、何时发生，再检查词性与动词结构。接着找关键词重音和可连接的词界，最后才调整细节声音。
body.en: First understand who does what and when. Then check word types and the verb group. Add clear stress and smooth word links.

concepts.example: She has booked an old room.
concepts.translation: 她已经预订了一间旧房间。
concepts.audioText: She has booked an old room.

title.zh: 不确定时知道怎样确认

body.zh: 不认识的词先用词素与拼读线索提出猜测，再查 US 音标、录音、词性和语境义项。学习目标是能可靠确认与表达，不是承诺无词典猜对每个词。
body.en: Use word parts and spelling to make a guess. Then check US sounds, word type, and meaning. Reliable checking matters more than guessing everything.

body.zh: 把这次考核中错过的题和新词加入个人复习册。下一轮先练最影响理解的一项，再在新句中重试；保留录音与观察，避免把自动分数当成全部能力。
body.en: Save hard questions and new words. Practice one important point next, then try a new sentence. A score is only one part of learning.

concepts.example: I can learn a little every day.
concepts.audioText: I can learn a little every day.

prompt.zh: 选择正确冠词。

explanation.zh: old 以元音音素开头，单数可数短语用 an old room。
explanation.en: Old starts with a vowel sound, so use an.

prompt.zh: has booked 是什么结构？

questions.text: She has booked an old room.

explanation.zh: has + 过去分词 booked 构成现在完成，booked 在此是动词形式。
explanation.en: Has plus the participle booked makes the present perfect.

prompt.zh: 哪个词界适合辅音接元音连读？
prompt.en: Which boundary joins a consonant to a vowel?

explanation.zh: have 末音 /v/ 可接 an 的首元音；old book 是辅音接辅音。
explanation.en: The v in have can link into the vowel in an.

prompt.zh: 听一听，选择听到的内容。

explanation.zh: children 是不规则复数，books 的 -s 读 /s/。
explanation.en: Children is irregular. Books ends with /s/.

prompt.zh: 把词块排成正确的句子。

questions.answer: She had left before I arrived.

explanation.zh: had left 表示在过去到达之前已经离开，两个事件有先后。
explanation.en: Had left happened before I arrived.

questions.audioText: She had left before I arrived.

prompt.zh: 先听，再录音跟读。注意本课的发音动作。
prompt.en: Listen. Then say it. Focus on this lesson.

questions.text: I can learn a little every day.
questions.answer: I can learn a little every day.

explanation.zh: 把 learn、little、day 读清楚，can 与 a 可轻；little 可有美式轻拍，不强求加速。
explanation.en: Keep learn, little, and day clear. Can and a can be light.
